subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Supreme Illusion, The Talent Whisperer, Superhuman EQ, Hunting with Eagles, and More

bullets.title: The Eagle Huntress
bullets.note: This documentary follows Aisholpan, a 13-year-old Kazakh girl, as she trains to become the first female in twelve generations of her family to become an eagle hunter, a tradition that has been handed down from father to son for centuries. You can [watch the trailer here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vfi5JS6HTH0).

bullets.title: Auren
bullets.note: “Auren and Seren are a new type of entity with superhuman emotional intelligence, memory, and therapeutic capability.” My team has been testing this app, and they find it helpful with a warning that the Seren personality can be challenging and confrontational. Hat tip to Ben Thompson from Stratechery who [found the app impressive](https://x.com/nearcyan/status/1911813024840908859) and its use as a life coach helpful. Pro tip: To preserve your privacy, after downloading the app on iOS, sign up with Apple and hide your name and email address.
